text: @kaorixbt "Fully autonomous team of 20 agents" is a great flex until agent #14 confidently wires money to the wrong vendor and nobody approved it. 20 agents doesn't cut your risk — it multiplies your blast radius by 20. Autonomy's the easy part. Accountability is the part everyone skips.
